single_variable_intervention: Replace the empty native-text evidence page with seven manually confirmed benchmark-bbox images covering the section title, explanatory paragraph, and five bullet items while holding the question, physical evidence page, model, reasoning effort, response schema, and zero-retry policy fixed.
interpretation: C2 had the correct physical page but no usable native text. Image-only C3 distinguished contextual regions from list items, counted five bullets rather than seven images, and recovered the benchmark-supported answer.
human_review_note: The user initially counted four items and then confirmed five after rechecking the short final item, showing that fragmented region presentation can itself create a counting risk.
scope_note: This is causal evidence for pilot_17 only and does not yet establish a general visual-routing policy.
